      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB\n",
        "from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt"

        "id": "UMmMyLQzDygy"

      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [

        "\n",
        "print(df1)\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# taking only the required data\n",
        "\n",
        "train_data = df1[[\"text\", \"sentiment\"]]\n",
        "print(train_data.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "test_data = df2[[\"text\", \"sentiment\"]]\n",
        "print(test_data.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "329w8c8sFO5E",

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# remove missing values\n",
        "\n",
        "train_data.dropna(how='any', inplace=True)\n",
        "test_data.dropna(how='any', inplace=True)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "DsuRAafoQL6Q",
        "outputId": "7e791e17-718e-4cff-f0ef-46663cc81be8"
      },
      "execution_count": null,

            "  train_data.dropna(how='any', inplace=True)\n",
            "<ipython-input-16-95d48cb31c6e>:4: SettingWithCopyWarning: \n",
            "A value is trying to be set on a copy of a slice from a DataFrame\n",

            "See the caveats in the documentation: https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/user_guide/indexing.html#returning-a-view-versus-a-copy\n",
            "  test_data.dropna(how='any', inplace=True)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# partitioning text and labels\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train = train_data.loc[:,\"text\"]\n",
        "y_train = train_data.loc[:,\"sentiment\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "X_test = test_data.loc[:,\"text\"]\n",
        "y_test = test_data.loc[:,\"sentiment\"]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "2bU_USGHl8Vp"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# apply bag-of-words\n",
        "\n",
        "count_vector = CountVectorizer(stop_words = 'english')\n",
        "X_train_bow = count_vector.fit_transform(X_train).toarray()\n",
        "X_test_bow = count_vector.transform(X_test)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "-8xlVPhJG-BJ"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# train the model\n",
        "\n",
        "MNB = MultinomialNB()\n",
        "MNB.fit(X_train_bow, y_train)"
      ],

        "colab": {
